local function v_u_47(p25, p26, p27, p28, p29) -- name: fade
	local v30 = #p25
	local v31 = p25[1]
	if p26 <= v31.rpm then
		local v32
		if v31.idle or p29 then
			v32 = 1
		else
			local v33 = (p26 - v31.rpm * 0.7) / (v31.rpm * 0.3)
			v32 = math.clamp(v33, 0, 1)
		end
		p27[v31] = (p27[v31] or 0) + p28 * v32
		return
	elseif p25[v30].rpm <= p26 then
		p27[p25[v30]] = (p27[p25[v30]] or 0) + p28
	else
		for v34 = 1, v30 - 1 do
			local v35 = p25[v34]
			local v36 = p25[v34 + 1]
			if p26 >= v36.rpm then
				continue
			end
			local v37 = p26 / v35.rpm
			local v38 = math.log(v37)
			local v39 = v36.rpm / v35.rpm
			local v40 = math.max(v39, 1.0001)
			local v41 = (v38 / math.log(v40) - 0.09999999999999998) / 0.8
			local v42 = math.clamp(v41, 0, 1)
			local v43 = p27[v35] or 0
			local v44 = v42 * 3.141592653589793 / 2
			p27[v35] = v43 + p28 * math.cos(v44)
			local v45 = p27[v36] or 0
			local v46 = v42 * 3.141592653589793 / 2
			p27[v36] = v45 + p28 * math.sin(v46)
			return
		end
	end
end
local function v_u_66(p48, p49, p50, p51) -- name: crossfade
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_47
	if #p48 == 0 or p51 <= 0 then
		return
	else
		local v52 = p48[1]
		local v53 = p48.rest
		if v52.idle and v53 then
			local v54 = v52.rpm * 1.5
			local v55 = not v53[1] and 0 or v53[1].rpm
			local v56 = math.max(v54, v55)
			local v57
			if p49 <= v52.rpm then
				v57 = 0
			else
				local v58 = p49 / v52.rpm
				local v59 = math.log(v58)
				local v60 = v56 / v52.rpm
				local v61 = v59 / math.log(v60)
				v57 = math.clamp(v61, 0, 1)
			end
			local v62 = p50[v52] or 0
			local v63 = v57 * 3.141592653589793 / 2
			p50[v52] = v62 + p51 * math.cos(v63)
			if v57 > 0 and #v53 > 0 then
				local v64 = v_u_47
				local v65 = v57 * 3.141592653589793 / 2
				v64(v53, p49, p50, p51 * math.sin(v65), true)
			end
		else
			v_u_47(p48, p49, p50, p51, false)
		end
	end
end

function v_u_67.destroy(p159) -- name: destroy
	for _, v160 in { p159.exhaust, p159.engine, p159.chassis } do
		if not v160 then
			continue
		end
		v160:Destroy()
	end
end
function v_u_67.place(p161, p162, p163, p164, p165) -- name: place
	local v166 = p162 - p161.seat.Position
	local v167 = v166.Magnitude
	local v168 = v167 <= 14 and 1 or (v167 / 14) ^ 0.2
	local v169 = (1500 - v167) / 400
	p161.lift = v168 * math.clamp(v169, 0, 1)
	local v170 = (v167 - 60) * 0.012
	p161.airHigh = -math.clamp(v170, 0, 14)
	local v171 = (v167 - 120) * 0.003
	p161.airMid = -math.clamp(v171, 0, 4)
	local v172
	if p165 or v167 <= 1 then
		v172 = 1
	else
		local v173 = v166 / v167
		local v174 = p161.seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(v173)
		local v175 = math.clamp(v174, -612.5, 612.5)
		local v176 = p163:Dot(v173)
		local v177 = (1225 - math.clamp(v176, -612.5, 612.5)) / (1225 - v175)
		v172 = math.clamp(v177, 0.6, 1.6)
	end
	local v178 = p161.doppler
	local _ = v178 < v172
	local v179 = 0.05
	local v180 = v172 - v178
	local v181 = -p164 / v179
	p161.doppler = v178 + v180 * (1 - math.exp(v181))
	p161.mine = p165
	p161.distance = v167
end
function v_u_67.sounding(p182) -- name: sounding
	local v183
	if p182.fade > 0.002 or (p182.squealLevel > 0.003 or (p182.scrubLevel > 0.003 or (p182.roarLevel > 0.003 or p182.gravelLevel > 0.003))) then
		v183 = true
	elseif p182.startShot == nil then
		v183 = false
	else
		v183 = p182.startShot.sound.IsPlaying
	end
	return v183
end
function v_u_67.rest(p184, p185) -- name: rest
	if p184.on ~= false then
		p184.offSince = p185
		p184:silence("rest")
	end
	p184.on = false
	p184.wasStarting = false
	p184.startedAt = nil
	p184.lastOnAt = nil
end
function v_u_67.silence(p186, p187) -- name: silence
	if workspace:GetAttribute("CarAudioDebug") then
		p186.car:SetAttribute("CarAudioSilenced", (p187 or "?") .. " @" .. string.format("%.1f", os.clock()))
	end
	for _, v188 in p186.entries do
		if v188.sound.IsPlaying then
			v188.sound:Stop()
		end
		v188.sound.Volume = 0
	end
	if p186.turbo then
		p186.turbo.sound:Stop()
	end
	if p186.kit then
		p186.kit:silence()
	end
	p186.squeal.sound:Stop()
	p186.scrub.sound:Stop()
	for _, v189 in { p186.roar, p186.gravel } do
		v189.sound:Stop()
	end
	p186.fade = 0
	p186.squealLevel = 0
	p186.scrubLevel = 0
	p186.roarLevel = 0
	p186.gravelLevel = 0
end
function v_u_67.update(p190, p191, p192, p193) -- name: update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_66
	p190.volume = (p190.car:GetAttribute("EngineVolume") or 1) * (p190.profile:GetAttribute("Volume") or 1)
	local v194 = p191.on
	if p191.remote then
		if p191.on then
			p190.lastOnAt = p193
		end
		v194 = p191.on
		if not v194 then
			if p190.lastOnAt == nil then
				v194 = false
			else
				v194 = p193 - p190.lastOnAt < 0.8
			end
		end

	if not v194 and p190.on ~= false then

local function v_u_434(p_u_430) -- name: considerCar
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_429, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_434

function v_u_1.update(p29, p30, p31, p32, p33, p34) -- name: update

	local v36 = p29.pedal
	local v37 = not p32 and 0 or p31
	local v38 = v36 < v37 and 0.08 or 0.05
	local v39 = v37 - v36
	local v40 = -p33 / v38
	p29.pedal = v36 + v39 * (1 - math.exp(v40))
	local v41 = p30.rpm
	local v42 = p30.redline
	local v43 = v41 / math.max(v42, 1)
	local v44 = math.clamp(v43, 0, 1.2)
	local v45 = v44 - v35.BoostFrom
	local v46 = v35.BoostFull - v35.BoostFrom
	local v47 = v45 / math.max(v46, 0.01)
	local v48 = math.clamp(v47, 0, 1)
	local v49 = p29.pedal * v48
	local v50 = p29.boost
	local v51 = v35.SpoolTime
	local v52 = v35.DumpTime

		v51 = v52 or v51
	end
	local v53 = v49 - v50
	local v54 = -p33 / v51
	p29.boost = v50 + v53 * (1 - math.exp(v54))
	local v55 = (v35.Reach - (p30.distance or 0)) / (v35.Reach * 0.6)
	local v56 = math.clamp(v55, 0, 1)
	local v57 = p30.volume * p30.lift * v56

		p29.highAt = p34
		p29.downSince = p29.downSince or p34
	elseif p31 < 0.5 and p29.downSince then
		p29.heldFor = p34 - p29.downSince
		p29.downSince = nil
	end
	if p29.boost < v35.SpoolBelow then
		p29.armed = true
	end
	local v58 = p29.shot
	if v58 then
		local v59 = v58.take.sound
		if v59.IsPlaying then
			local v60 = (v59.TimePosition - v58.take.from) / v58.length
			local v61 = math.clamp(v60, 0, 1)
			local v62 = v61 / 0.06
			local v63 = math.min(1, v62)
			if v61 > 0.6 then
				local v64 = (v61 - 0.6) / 0.4 * 3.141592653589793 / 2
				v63 = v63 * math.cos(v64)
			end

				local v65 = v58.release
				local v66 = -p33 / 0.07
				v58.release = v65 * math.exp(v66)
			end
			v58.env = v63 * v58.release
			if v58.release < 0.02 then
				v59:Stop()
				p29.shot = nil
			else
				v59.Volume = v58.take.gain * (0.55 + 0.45 * p29.pedal) * v57 * v58.env
			end
		else
			p29.shot = nil
		end
	end

		local v67 = p29.spools
		local v68 = p29.lastSpoolTake
		local v69
		if #v67 == 0 then
			v69 = nil
		else
			v69 = v67[math.random(1, #v67)]
			if v69 == v68 and #v67 > 1 then
				v69 = v67[table.find(v67, v69) % #v67 + 1]
			end
		end
		if v69 then
			local v70 = v69.sound
			local v71 = (v69.to or v70.TimeLength) - v69.from
			if v71 > 0.05 then
				p29.armed = false

				p29.shot = {
					["take"] = nil,
					["length"] = nil,
					["env"] = 0,
					["release"] = 1,
					["take"] = v69,
					["length"] = v71
				}
				v70.Volume = 0
				v70.PlaybackSpeed = v69.pitch * (math.min(v44, 1) * 0.2 + 0.92) * p30.doppler
				v70.TimePosition = v69.from
				v70:Play()

			end
		end
	end
	local v72 = p29.whistle
	if v72 then
		local v73 = not p29.shot and 1 or 1 - 0.6 * p29.shot.env
		local v74 = v72.gain * p29.boost ^ 1.4 * p30.volume * p30.fade * p30.lift * v56 * v73

			if not v72.sound.IsPlaying then
				local v75 = v72.sound
				local v76 = math.random()
				local v77 = v72.sound.TimeLength - 0.2
				v75.TimePosition = v76 * math.max(v77, 0)
				v72.sound:Play()
			end
			v72.sound.Volume = v74
			v72.sound.PlaybackSpeed = v72.pitch * (0.6 + 0.45 * p29.boost + math.min(v44, 1) * 0.15) * p30.doppler
		elseif v72.sound.IsPlaying then
			v72.sound:Stop()
		end
	end
	if p32 and (p31 < 0.2 and (p34 - p29.highAt < 0.3 and (p29.boost > v35.FlutterMinBoost and (p29.heldFor >= v35.FlutterHold and (p34 - p29.lastFlutter > v35.FlutterGap and v57 > 0.001))))) then
		p29.highAt = (-1 / 0)
		local v78 = p29.flutters
		local v79 = p29.lastFlutterTake
		local v80
		if #v78 == 0 then
			v80 = nil
		else
			v80 = v78[math.random(1, #v78)]
			if v80 == v79 and #v78 > 1 then
				v80 = v78[table.find(v78, v80) % #v78 + 1]
			end
		end
		if v80 then
			p29.lastFlutter = p34
			p29.lastFlutterTake = v80
			local v81 = v80.sound
			v81.Volume = v80.gain * (0.4 + 0.6 * p29.boost) * v57
			v81.PlaybackSpeed = v80.pitch * (0.95 + math.random() * 0.1) * p30.doppler
			v81.TimePosition = v80.from
			v81:Play()
			p29:note("flutter", v80, p34)
		end
	end
	if workspace:GetAttribute("CarAudioDebug") then
		p29.car:SetAttribute("TurboKitDebug", string.format("boost %.2f goal %.2f pedal %.2f whistle %.3f spool %.3f taper %.2f", p29.boost, v49, p29.pedal, not v72 and 0 or v72.sound.Volume, not p29.shot and 0 or p29.shot.take.sound.Volume, v56))
	end
end

	end

end

function v_u_3.stepPitch(p57, p58) -- name: stepPitch
	local v59 = p57.weight
	local v60 = p57.wheels
	if not v59.Parent then
		return p57:stop()
	end
	local v61 = v59.CFrame
	local v62 = v61.LookVector
	local _ = v61.RightVector
	local v63 = v61.UpVector
	local v64 = v59.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local v65 = v64:Dot(v62)
	if p57.lastV then
		local v66 = (v65 - p57.lastV) / math.max(p58, 0.004166666666666667)
		local v67 = p57.aF
		local v68 = math.clamp(v66, -105, 105) - p57.aF
		local v69 = p58 / 0.06

	end

	local v70 = p57.mass * p57.aF - p57.D:Dot(v62)
	local v71 = v59:FindFirstChild("_ArcadeForce")
	if v71 and v71:IsA("VectorForce") then
		v70 = v70 - v71.Force:Dot(v62)
	end
	local v72 = 0
	for _, v73 in v60 do
		local v74 = v73.Size.Y
		local v75 = v73.Size.Z
		local v76 = math.max(v74, v75) / 2
		if not workspace:Raycast(v73.Position, -v63 * (v76 + 0.25), p57.params) then
			continue
		end
		v72 = v72 + 1
	end
	local v77
	if v72 == 4 and v63.Y > 0.9 then
		local v78 = p57.aF
		v77 = math.abs(v78) < 98 and 1 or 0
	else
		v77 = 0
	end
	local v79 = p57.fade
	local v80 = v77 - p57.fade
	local v81 = p58 / 0.08
	p57.fade = v79 + v80 * math.min(1, v81)
	local v82 = -v70 * p57.h / p57.L * p57.k * p57.fade
	local v83 = -1.5 * p57.mass * 35
	local v84 = 1.5 * p57.mass * 35
	local v85 = math.clamp(v82, v83, v84)
	p57.dW = v85
	local v86
	if p57.level then
		local v87 = {}
		for v88 = 1, 2 do
			local v89 = p57.axleForce[v88].Attachment0.WorldPosition
			local v90 = workspace:Raycast(v89, -v63 * 8, p57.params)
			v87[v88] = v90 and v90.Distance or nil
		end
		local v91 = v64.Magnitude
		if v72 == 4 and (v63.Y > 0.9 and v91 < 2) then
			p57.still = p57.still + p58
			for v92 = 1, 2 do
				if p57.still > 0.5 and v87[v92] then
					local v93 = p57.L0
					local v94
					if p57.L0[v92] then
						local v95 = p57.L0[v92]
						local v96 = v87[v92] - p57.L0[v92]
						local v97 = p58 / 1
						v94 = v95 + v96 * math.min(1, v97)
					else
						v94 = v87[v92]
					end
					v93[v92] = v94
				end
				local v98 = p57.I
				local v99 = v98[v92]
				local v100 = 1 - p58 / 0.5
				v98[v92] = v99 * math.max(0, v100)
				p57.eF[v92] = 0
			end
		else
			p57.still = 0
			local v101 = p57.aF
			local v102
			if math.abs(v101) < 10.5 then
				v102 = p57.fade > 0.9
			else
				v102 = false
			end
			for v103 = 1, 2 do
				if not (p57.L0[v103] and v87[v103]) then
					continue
				end
				local v104 = p57.L0[v103] - v87[v103]
				local v105 = p57.eF
				local v106 = v105[v103]
				local v107 = v104 - p57.eF[v103]
				local v108 = p58 / 0.3
				v105[v103] = v106 + v107 * math.min(1, v108)
				if not v102 then
					continue
				end

				local v110 = p57.I

				local v112 = -v109
				v110[v103] = math.clamp(v111, v112, v109)
			end
		end

	else
		v86 = { 0, 0 }
	end
	local v113 = v85 + v86[1]
	local v114 = -v85 + v86[2]
	if p57.axleForce then
		p57.axleForce[1].Force = v63 * v113
		p57.axleForce[2].Force = v63 * v114
	end
	p57:writeWheels(-v63 * (v113 / 2), -v63 * (v114 / 2))
	if p57.car:GetAttribute("RideDebug") then
		p57.car:SetAttribute("_RideDW", (math.floor(v85)))
		p57.car:SetAttribute("_RideFx", (math.floor(v70)))
		p57.car:SetAttribute("_RideContacts", v72)

		local v117 = p57.car
		local v118 = v86[2]
		v117:SetAttribute("_RideLevR", (math.floor(v118)))
	end
end

function v_u_3.apply(p125, p126, p127, p128) -- name: apply
	p125.D = p128 or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	if p125.dragForce then
		p125.dragForce.Force = p125.D
	end
	if p125.dfForce then
		p125.dfForce.Force = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

		p125.drForce.Force = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

	local v132 = math.clamp(v131, 0, 1)

	local v134 = p127 * v132
	if p125.arcade then
		local v135 = p125.car
		local v136 = -v133:Dot(v130)

		local v138 = -v134:Dot(v130)
		v137:SetAttribute("_AeroLoadR", (math.max(v138, 0)))
		return
	elseif p125.forces[4] then
		local v139 = -v130
		local v140 = -v133:Dot(v130)
		p125.front = v139 * math.max(v140, 0)
		local v141 = -v130
		local v142 = -v134:Dot(v130)

	else
		if p125.dfForce then
			p125.dfForce.Force = v133
		end
		if p125.drForce then
			p125.drForce.Force = v134
		end
	end
end

function v_u_3.stepRight(p161, p162) -- name: stepRight
	local v163 = p161.right
	local v164 = v163.seat
	if v164.Parent then
		local v165 = v164.CFrame
		local v166 = v165.UpVector
		local v167 = v164.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		if not v163.phase then
			local v168 = v167.X
			local v169 = v167.Z
			local v170 = Vector3.new(v168, 0, v169)
			local v171 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			if v166.Y < 0.3 then
				local v172 = workspace
				local v173 = v164.Position
				local v174 = -v163.ext[2]
				if v172:Raycast(v173, Vector3.new(0, v174, 0), v163.params) and v170.Magnitude > 0.5 then
					local v175 = -v170.Unit * v164.AssemblyMass
					local v176 = v170.Magnitude * 8
					v171 = v175 * math.min(31.5, v176)
				end
			end
			v163.lift.Force = v171
			if v166.Y < 0.3 and v167.Magnitude < 6 then
				v163.t = v163.t + p162
			else
				local v177 = v163.t + p162
				v163.t = math.min(v177, 0)
			end
			if v163.t < 1 then
				return
			end
			local v178 = v165.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			if v178.Magnitude < 0.3 then
				v178 = v166 * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			end
			v163.goal = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v178.Unit, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
			local v179 = v163.ext
			local v180 = v165.LookVector.Y
			local v181
			if math.abs(v180) > 0.7 then
				v181 = v179[3] / 2
			else
				local v182 = v179[1] ^ 2 + v179[2] ^ 2
				v181 = math.sqrt(v182) * 0.5
			end
			v163.clear = v181 + 0.6
			local v183 = os.clock()
			local v184 = os.clock()
			v163.phase = "lift"
			v163.t0 = v183
			v163.tp = v184
			v163.target = nil
			v163.i = 0
		end
		local v185 = p161.car:GetBoundingBox().Position
		local v186 = workspace:Raycast(v185, Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), v163.params)
		if not v186 or os.clock() - v163.t0 > 6 then
			return p161:endRight()
		end
		local v187 = v185.Y - v186.Position.Y
		local v188 = v163.target
		if not v188 then
			local v189 = v163.clear
			v188 = math.max(v187, v189)
		end
		v163.target = v188
		local v190 = os.clock() - v163.tp
		if v163.phase == "lift" then
			v163.target = v163.clear
			if v163.clear - 0.25 < v187 or v190 > 1.5 then
				local v191 = os.clock()
				v163.phase = "turn"
				v163.tp = v191

function v_u_5.place(p82) -- name: place

end

local function v_u_124(p_u_109, p_u_110, p111) -- name: onPlace

	end
end

function v_u_13.pad(p208, p209) -- name: pad
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_84, (copy) v_u_207, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_89, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_13

				return true
			end
		end
		local v211 = v_u_207[p208]
		if v211 then

				local v213 = v_u_19.focus - 1

				local v221 = math.clamp(v219, 0, v220) * v212 + v218 + 1

				if v223 ~= v_u_19.focus and v_u_10 then

		elseif p208 == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
			local v225 = v_u_19.tiles[v_u_19.focus]

				if v210 then
					v_u_89(v225)

						v_u_19.held[v226] = nil

		else

function v_u_25.result(p_u_341, p342) -- name: result
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_211, (copy) v_u_50
	if p_u_341.phase ~= "done" then

		v_u_24:SetAttribute("StoryScoring", nil)

			v_u_11.stop(p_u_341.car)
		end
		if p_u_341.rails then
			p_u_341.rails:destroy()
			p_u_341.rails = nil
		end
		p_u_341.world.hold = p_u_341.out and p_u_341.out.v or v_u_22.ROLL_SPEED
		p_u_341.world.rubber = 0
		p_u_341.world.extra = nil
		p_u_341.coast = p_u_341.me.v
		local v343 = v_u_7.laneOf(p_u_341.me.x)
		local v344 = p_u_341.out
		if v344 then
			local v345 = v344.p - p_u_341.me.p
			if math.abs(v345) < 150 then
				local v346 = v_u_7.laneX(v343) - v344.x
				if math.abs(v346) < v_u_7.laneX(2) - v_u_7.laneX(1) - 2 then
					local v347 = p_u_341.me.x >= v344.x and 1 or -1
					if v343 + v347 < 1 or v343 + v347 > v_u_7.LANES then
						v347 = -v347
					end
					local v348 = v343 + v347
					local v349 = v_u_7.laneX(v348) - v344.x
					local v350 = math.abs(v349)
					local v351 = v_u_7.laneX(v343) - v344.x
					if v350 < math.abs(v351) then
						v348 = v343 - v347
					end
					local v352 = v_u_7.LANES
					v343 = math.clamp(v348, 1, v352)
				end
			end
		end
		p_u_341.coastX = v_u_7.laneX(v343)
		if not p_u_341.holding and p_u_341.seat then
			p_u_341.holding = v_u_4.PreSimulation:Connect(function(p353)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_211, (copy) p_u_341

end
function v_u_25.pause(p354, p355) -- name: pause
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_240, (copy) v_u_249, (copy) v_u_50
	if p354.phase == "done" then
		return
	elseif p355 then
		if p354.paused or p354.pauseAtGo then
			return
		elseif p354.phase == "race" or p354.phase == "finish" then
			v_u_240(p354)
		else
			p354.pauseAtGo = true
		end
	else
		local v356 = p354.pausedAtGo == true
		p354.pauseAtGo = nil
		p354.pausedAtGo = nil
		if p354.paused then
			v_u_249(p354)
			v_u_50(p354, "phase", "resume", {
				["go"] = v356
			})
		end
		return
	end
end
function v_u_25.stop(p357) -- name: stop
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_249, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_50

			v_u_249(p357)
		end

		end

			p357.rails:destroy()
			p357.rails = nil
		end

		end
		table.clear(p357.gone)
		if p357.holding then
			p357.holding:Disconnect()
			p357.holding = nil
		end
		if p357.bound then
			v_u_4:UnbindFromRenderStep("StoryRace")
			p357.bound = false
		end
		if p357.simClock then
			p357.simClock:Disconnect()
			p357.simClock = nil
		end
		if p357.audio then
			p357.audio:destroy()
			p357.audio = nil
		end
		if p357.rivalCar then
			p357.rivalCar:destroy()
			p357.rivalCar = nil
		end
		if p357.gate then

			p357.gate = nil
		end
		if p357.makeWay then

			p357.makeWay = nil
		end
		if p357.driver then

			p357.driver = nil
		end
		if p357.pilot then
			p357.pilot:destroy()
			p357.pilot = nil

function v_u_5.step(p21, p22, p23, p24) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v25 = p21.ai

		v26 = p24.extra[1]
	end
	local v27 = nil
	local v28 = v_u_4.GAIN

			local v48 = math.clamp(v47, 0, 1)

			local v51 = p21.meV - v_u_4.FAST_FROM

		end

		local v76 = -v69 * p22

		v25.v = v78
		local v79 = v25.p

function v_u_4.update(p22, p23, p24, p25, p26) -- name: update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3

		p22.part.CFrame = p23 * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)

		local v28 = p22.redline * p24 / (p22.top * v_u_3[v27])

		end

		local v30 = p22.redline * p24 / (p22.top * v_u_3[v29])

		local v35 = 1 - math.exp(v34)

		local v36 = p22.throttle
		local v37 = (p25 > -3 and 1 or 0.2) - p22.throttle

		p22.throttle = v36 + v37 * (1 - math.exp(v38))

				continue
			end

		end

		local v45 = #v39
		local v46 = math.min(v44, v45)
		local v47

			v47 = 0
		else
			local v48 = (v41 - v39[v42].log) / (v39[v46].log - v39[v42].log)
			v47 = math.clamp(v48, 0, 1)
		end

end

	local v52 = math.floor(v51)

		p42.hi = v53
		local v54 = p42.pieces
		for v55, v56 in v54 do
			if v55 >= v48 and v53 >= v55 then
				continue
			end
			v56:Destroy()
			v54[v55] = nil
		end
		local v57 = 0
		for v58 = v48, v53 do
			if v54[v58] then
				continue
			end
			v54[v58] = v_u_41(p42, v58)
			v57 = v57 + 1
			if v_u_4.PER_FRAME > v57 then
				continue
			end

		end
	end
end

function v_u_3.finishesOf(p8) -- name: finishesOf
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3

end
function v_u_3.finishOf(p9, p10) -- name: finishOf
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v11 = p10 or v_u_3.ById.Paint
	local v12 = not p9[v11.finishAttr] and v11.stockFinishAttr
	if v12 then
		v12 = p9[v11.stockFinishAttr]
	end
	for _, v13 in v_u_3.finishesOf(v11) do
		if v13.id ~= v12 then
			continue
		end
		return v12
	end
	return v11.defaultFinish
end

function v_u_3.dirtLevel(p14) -- name: dirtLevel
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v15 = nil
	for _, v16 in v_u_3.Dirt do
		if type(p14) ~= "number" or v16.from > p14 then
			continue
		end
		v15 = v16.id
	end
	return v15
end

local function v_u_125(p103, p104, p105, p106, p107) -- name: caliperShift
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6

		return 0
	end
	local v108 = v_u_6.LO
	local v109 = v_u_6.STEP
	local v110 = p107.Y
	local v111 = p107.Z
	local v112 = math.max(v110, v111) / 2 / (p105 * p106)
	local v113 = 0
	for v114, v115 in p103.cal do
		local v116 = (v108 + (v114 - 1) * v109) * v112
		local v117 = (v108 + v114 * v109) * v112
		local v118 = (v116 - v108) / v109

function v_u_5.subject(p75, p76, p77) -- name: subject
	local v78 = p75.metrics
	local v79 = v78.centre
	local v80 = v78.height * (p76.lift or 0)
	local v81 = v79 + Vector3.new(0, v80, 0)
	if p76.focus == "tail" then
		local v82 = v78.exhaust
		if not v82 then
			local v83 = v78.centre
			local v84 = -v78.height * 0.2
			local v85 = v78.length * 0.45
			v82 = v83 + Vector3.new(0, v84, v85)
		end
		local v86 = v78.centre.X
		local v87 = v82.Y
		local v88 = v82.Z
		local v89 = Vector3.new(v86, v87, v88)
		local v90 = v78.height * (p76.lift or 0) + v78.height * 0.15
		v81 = v89 + Vector3.new(0, v90, 0)
	else
		local v91 = p76.focus
		if string.sub(v91, 1, 5) == "wheel" then
			local v92 = v78.wheels
			local v93 = p76.focus
			local v94 = v92[string.sub(v93, 6)]
			if v94 then
				local v95 = v78.radius * (p76.lift or 0)
				v81 = v94 + Vector3.new(0, v95, 0)
			end
		end
	end
	local v96 = p76.size[1]
	local v97 = p76.size[2]
	local v98
	if v96 == "wheel" then
		v98 = v78.radius * 2 * v97
	elseif v96 == "width" then
		v98 = v78.width * v97
	else
		local v99 = math.rad(p77)
		local v100 = v78.length
		local v101 = math.sin(v99)
		local v102 = v100 * math.abs(v101)
		local v103 = v78.width
		local v104 = math.cos(v99)
		v98 = (v102 + v103 * math.abs(v104)) * v97
	end
	return v81, v98
end

function v_u_5.fade(p437, p_u_438, p439) -- name: fade

function v_u_5.step(p212, p213, p214, p215, p216) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13
	if p212.car then
		p212.onWheel = p215 == true
		p212:apply()
		if p212.keyLight and p212.keyWant then
			local v217 = p212.keyLight.Brightness
			local v218 = p212.keyLight
			local v219 = p212.keyWant - v217
			local v220 = (p216 or 0.016) * 4
			v218.Brightness = v217 + v219 * math.min(v220, 1)
		end
		local v221 = v_u_13()
		local v222 = os.clock()
		if not (v221 and v221.off) and p212.scanAt <= v222 then
			p212.scanAt = v222 + 0.5
			p212:scanLights()
		end
		if p212.key then
			p212.key.CFrame = p213 * CFrame.new(0, 3, 1)
			local v223 = p212.keyLight
			local v224 = (p213.Position - p214).Magnitude * 1.6
			v223.Range = math.clamp(v224, 16, 60)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_5.release(p225) -- name: release
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_22
	for v_u_226, v227 in p225.held do
		for v_u_228, v_u_229 in v227 do
			local function v230()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_226, (copy) v_u_228, (copy) v_u_229
				if v_u_22(v_u_226[v_u_228], v_u_229.ours) then
					v_u_226[v_u_228] = v_u_229.restore
				end
			end
			pcall(v230)
		end

function v_u_4.effectText(p46, p47, p48) -- name: effectText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	if p46.id == "Engine" then
		if p47.hp then
			return ("%d HP"):format(p47.hp)
		end
		if p47.rarity then
			local v49 = v_u_4.rarityTargets()[p47.rarity]
			if type(p48) ~= "number" then
				return not v49 and "MAX TUNE" or ("BEST %s CARS +20%%"):format(string.upper(p47.rarity))
			end

		end

		local v52 = (p47.power - 1) * 100 + 0.5

		local v54 = (v53 >= 0 and "+" or "") .. v53 .. "%"

	end

			local v58 = math.floor(v57)
			return ((v58 >= 0 and "+" or "") .. v58 .. "%") .. " REAR GRIP  \194\183  SLIDES"
		end
		if not p47.grip then
			return "NO UPGRADE"
		end
		local v59 = (p47.grip - 1) * 100 + 0.5
		local v60 = math.floor(v59)
		return ((v60 >= 0 and "+" or "") .. v60 .. "%") .. " GRIP"
	end
	if p46.id == "Brakes" then
		if not p47.brake then
			return "NO UPGRADE"
		end
		local v61 = (p47.brake - 1) * 100 + 0.5
		local v62 = math.floor(v61)
		return ((v62 >= 0 and "+" or "") .. v62 .. "%") .. " BRAKE FORCE"
	end
	if p46.id ~= "Weight" then
		return ""
	end
	if not p47.mass then
		return "NO UPGRADE"
	end
	local v63 = (p47.mass - 1) * 100 + 0.5
	local v64 = math.floor(v63)

	local v66 = ((p47.power or 1) - 1) * 100 + 0.5

end

function v_u_4.gearTop(p86, p87) -- name: gearTop
	local v88 = p86:FindFirstChild("Wheels")
	local v89 = not v88 or v88:FindFirstChild("RL") or (v88:FindFirstChild("RR") or v88:FindFirstChild("R"))
	local v90 = p87.Ratios
	local v91
	if type(v90) == "table" then
		v91 = p87.Ratios
	else
		v91 = false
	end

		return nil
	end

	local v93 = math.abs(v92) * p87.FinalDrive * (p87.FDMult or 1)
	if v93 <= 0 then

			if v207 - (v214.seatAt or -1) > 0.25 then
				v214.seatAt = v207

			end

					v214.fade = math.min(v216, v217)

				end
			end

				local v220 = v214.targetColor
				local v221 = v219.R - v220.R

				local v224 = v222 + math.abs(v223)

				else

				end
			end

						end
					end

					v214.drawn = nil
					v_u_12[v213] = nil
				else
					v_u_176(v214)
				end
			else
				local v228 = v213:FindFirstChild("DriveSeat")
				local v229 = not v228 and (1 / 0) or (v228.Position - v212).Magnitude

					end

					end

				end
			end
			v214.inst = nil
			v214.drawn = nil
			v_u_12[v213] = nil
		end
	end
end

function v_u_29.rebuild(p127) -- name: rebuild
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_6
	for _, v128 in p127.cards do
		v128:Destroy()
	end
	p127.cards = {}
	p127.tiers = v_u_7.tiersOf(v_u_11)
	local v129 = p127.cards
	table.insert(v129, p127:buyMoreCard())
	local v130 = {}
	for _, v131 in p127.owned do
		local v132 = v_u_6.ById[v131]
		if not v132 then
			continue
		end
		local v133 = {
			["car"] = v132,
			["rating"] = v_u_7.ofCar(v131, p127.tiers[v131]) or -1
		}
		table.insert(v130, v133)
	end
	table.sort(v130, function(p134, p135)
		if p134.rating == p135.rating then
			return p134.car.order < p135.car.order
		else
			return p134.rating < p135.rating
		end
	end)
	for v136, v137 in v130 do
		local v138 = p127.cards
		local v139 = v137.car
		table.insert(v138, p127:carCard(v139, v136))
	end
	p127:filter()
end
function v_u_29.filter(p140) -- name: filter
	local v141 = string.lower(p140.searchBox.Text)
	local v142 = string.gsub(v141, "^%s+", "")
	local v143 = string.gsub(v142, "%s+$", "")
	local v144 = false
	for _, v145 in p140.cards do
		local v146 = v145:GetAttribute("Search")
		local v147
		if v143 == "" then
			v147 = true
		elseif v146 == nil then
			v147 = false
		else
			v147 = string.find(v146, v143, 1, true) ~= nil
		end
		local v148
		if v147 then
			v148 = v147
		elseif v145:GetAttribute("Always") == true then
			v148 = v143 == ""
		else
			v148 = false
		end
		v145.Visible = v148
		if not (v147 and v146) then
			continue
		end
		v144 = true
	end
	local v149 = p140.empty
	local v150
	if v143 == "" then
		v150 = false
	else
		v150 = not v144
	end
	v149.Visible = v150
end

end

function v_u_29.act(p_u_171, p_u_172, p_u_173, p174) -- name: act
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_8
	if p_u_171.pending then
		return
	else
		p_u_171.pending = true
		p_u_171:message(p174, v_u_9.white)
		local v175, v176, v177, v178 = pcall(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_171, (copy) p_u_172, (copy) p_u_173
			return p_u_171.request:InvokeServer(p_u_172, p_u_173)
		end)
		p_u_171.pending = false
		if v175 then
			if v176 then
				if p_u_172 == "spawn" then
					p_u_171:message(v177, v_u_9.green)
					p_u_171:close()
					p_u_171:showGetIn()
				else
					p_u_171:message(v177, v_u_9.green)
				end
			else
				p_u_171:message(v177 or "Something went wrong", v_u_9.red)
				if p_u_172 == "spawn" and v178 == "members" then
					p_u_171:close()
					v_u_8.request("Store", "Featured", "Dealer_Featured")
				elseif p_u_172 == "spawn" and v178 then
					p_u_171:showRefused(v178)
				end
			end
		else
			p_u_171:message("Something went wrong", v_u_9.red)
			return
		end
	end
end

function v_u_29.obstacles(_) -- name: obstacles
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_39
	local v197 = v_u_11.PlayerGui
	local v198 = v197:FindFirstChild("ScreenGui")
	local v199 = {}
	local v200 = {}
	local v201 = {}
	if v198 then
		local v202 = v198:FindFirstChild("CarUI")
		if v202 and v_u_39(v202) then
			for _, v203 in v202:GetDescendants() do
				if not v203:IsA("GuiObject") or (v203.AbsoluteSize.X <= 1 or not v_u_39(v203)) then
					continue
				end
				table.insert(v199, v203)
			end
		end
		for _, v204 in { "Buttons", "Map", "Cash" } do
			local v205 = v198:FindFirstChild(v204)
			if not (v205 and v_u_39(v205)) then
				continue
			end
			for _, v206 in v205:GetChildren() do
				if not (v206:IsA("GuiObject") and v_u_39(v206)) then
					continue
				end
				table.insert(v200, v206)
			end
		end
		local v207 = v198:FindFirstChild("Level")
		if v207 and v_u_39(v207) then
			table.insert(v201, v207)
		end
	end
	local v208 = v197:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
	if v208 then
		v208 = v208:FindFirstChild("JumpButton", true)
	end
	if v208 and v_u_39(v208) then
		table.insert(v199, v208)
	end
	local v209 = v197:FindFirstChild("A-Chassis Interface")
	if v209 then
		v209 = v209:FindFirstChild("RadialGauge", true)
	end
	if v209 and (v209:IsA("GuiObject") and v_u_39(v209)) then
		table.insert(v201, v209)
	end
	for _, v210 in { "TuningGaragePrompt", "CarWashPrompt" } do
		local v211 = v197:FindFirstChild(v210)
		if not (v211 and v211.Enabled) then
			continue
		end
		for _, v212 in v211:GetChildren() do
			if not (v212:IsA("GuiObject") and v212.Visible) then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(v201, v212)
		end
	end
	return v199, v200, v201
end

function v_u_29.layout(p216) -- name: layout
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_27
	local v217 = p216.root
	local v218 = v217.AbsoluteSize.X
	local v219 = v217.AbsoluteSize.Y
	if v218 < 50 or v219 < 50 then
		return
	else
		local v220 = v217.AbsolutePosition
		local v221 = v219 * 0.014
		local v222 = math.floor(v221)
		local v223 = math.max(8, v222)
		local v224 = v_u_2.TopbarInset.Max.Y
		local v225 = v224 + v223
		local v226 = v219 - v223
		local v227 = v218 - v223
		local v228, v229, v230 = p216:obstacles()
		local v231 = v223
		for _, v232 in v228 do
			local v233 = v232.AbsolutePosition - v220
			local v234 = v233.X
			local v235 = v233.Y
			local _ = v233.X + v232.AbsoluteSize.X
			local v236 = v233.Y + v232.AbsoluteSize.Y
			if v218 * 0.55 >= v234 or (v225 >= v236 or v235 >= v226) then
				continue
			end
			local v237 = v234 - v223
			v227 = math.min(v227, v237)
		end
		for _, v238 in v229 do
			local v239 = v238.AbsolutePosition - v220
			local _ = v239.X
			local _ = v239.Y
			local v240 = v239.X + v238.AbsoluteSize.X
			local _ = v239.Y + v238.AbsoluteSize.Y
			if v240 >= v218 * 0.45 then
				continue
			end
			local v241 = v240 + v223
			v231 = math.max(v231, v241)
		end
		local v242 = v_u_27()
		local v243 = (v226 - v225) * (v242 and 1.75 or 0.58)
		local v244 = math.floor(v243)
		local v245 = math.clamp(v244, 250, v242 and 560 or 380)
		local v246 = v227 - v231
		local v247 = math.min(v245, v246)
		local v248, v249
		if v242 then
			local v250 = v219 * 0.1
			local v251 = math.floor(v250)
			v248 = math.clamp(v251, 32, 44)
			v249 = 8
		else
			local v252 = v247 / 340
			local v253 = 12 * v252 + 0.5
			v249 = math.floor(v253)
			local v254 = 46 * v252
			v248 = math.floor(v254)
		end
		local v255 = v224 + 12 - (v249 + v248 / 2)
		local v256 = math.ceil(v255)
		local v257 = math.max(v225, v256)
		local v258 = (v226 - v257) * (v242 and 1.75 or 0.58)
		local v259 = math.floor(v258)
		local v260 = math.clamp(v259, 250, v242 and 560 or 380)
		local v261 = v227 - v231
		local v262 = math.min(v260, v261)
		local v263 = v257
		local v264 = v226
		for _, v265 in v230 do
			local v266 = v265.AbsolutePosition - v220
			local v267 = v266.X
			local v268 = v266.Y
			local v269 = v266.X + v265.AbsoluteSize.X
			local v270 = v266.Y + v265.AbsoluteSize.Y
			if v227 - v262 >= v269 or v267 >= v227 then
				continue
			end
			if v219 * 0.5 < v268 then
				local v271 = v268 - v223
				v226 = math.min(v226, v271)
			else
				local v272 = v270 + v223
				v257 = math.max(v257, v272)
			end
		end
		local v273 = v226 - v257
		local v274 = (v264 - v263) * 0.55
		if math.max(220, v274) <= v273 then
			local v275 = (v226 - v257) * (v242 and 1.75 or 0.58)
			local v276 = math.floor(v275)
			local v277 = math.clamp(v276, 250, v242 and 560 or 380)
			local v278 = v227 - v231
			v262 = math.min(v277, v278)
		else
			v257 = v263
			v226 = v264
		end
		local v279 = v226 - v257
		local v280 = table.concat({
			v227 - v262,
			v257,
			v262,
			v279,
			(tostring(v242))
		}, ",")
		p216.target = UDim2.fromOffset(v227 - v262, v257)
		p216.hidden = UDim2.fromOffset(v218 + 12, v257)
		if v280 ~= p216.layoutKey then
			p216.layoutKey = v280
			local v281 = v262 / 340
			local v282, v283
			if v242 then
				local v284 = v219 * 0.1
				local v285 = math.floor(v284)
				v282 = math.clamp(v285, 32, 44)
				v283 = 8
			else
				local v286 = v262 / 340
				local v287 = 12 * v286 + 0.5
				v283 = math.floor(v287)
				local v288 = 46 * v286
				v282 = math.floor(v288)
			end
			local v289 = p216.panel
			v289.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v262, v279)
			if p216.isOpen and not p216.sliding then
				v289.Position = p216.target
			end
			local v290 = UDim.new
			local v291 = 0
			local v292
			if v242 then
				v292 = 12
			else
				local v293 = 14 * v281
				v292 = math.floor(v293)
			end
			local v294 = v290(v291, v292)
			p216.panelCorner.CornerRadius = v294
			p216.dimCorner.CornerRadius = v294
			p216.closeButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
			local v295, v296, v297
			if v242 then
				local v298 = v282 * 0.82
				local v299 = math.floor(v298)
				p216.titleIcon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v283, v283 + (v282 - v299) / 2)
				p216.titleIcon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v299, v299)
				local v300 = v282 * 0.6
				local v301 = math.floor(v300)
				local v302 = v283 + v299 + 6
				local v303 = v262 * 0.27

function v_u_29.open(p_u_369) -- name: open
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_14
	if not p_u_369.isOpen then
		p_u_369.isOpen = true
		p_u_369.layoutKey = ""
		v_u_8.open("Spawner")
		p_u_369:rebuild()
		p_u_369:message(nil)
		p_u_369:hideJump(true)
		p_u_369:layout()
		local v_u_370 = p_u_369.panel
		v_u_370.Position = p_u_369.hidden
		v_u_370.Visible = true
		p_u_369.sliding = true
		local v371 = v_u_5:Create(v_u_370, v_u_14, {
			["Position"] = p_u_369.target
		})
		v371.Completed:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_369, (copy) v_u_370
			p_u_369.sliding = false
			if p_u_369.isOpen then
				v_u_370.Position = p_u_369.target
			end
		end)
		v371:Play()
	end
end
function v_u_29.close(p_u_372) -- name: close
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_15
	if p_u_372.isOpen then
		p_u_372.isOpen = false
		p_u_372:answer(false)
		p_u_372.searchBox:ReleaseFocus()
		p_u_372:hideJump(false)
		local v_u_373 = p_u_372.panel
		p_u_372.sliding = true
		local v374 = v_u_5:Create(v_u_373, v_u_15, {
			["Position"] = p_u_372.hidden or UDim2.fromScale(1.1, 0.15)
		})
		v374.Completed:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_372, (copy) v_u_373
			p_u_372.sliding = false
			if not p_u_372.isOpen then
				v_u_373.Visible = false
			end
		end)
		v374:Play()
	end
end
function v_u_29.toggle(p375) -- name: toggle
	if p375.isOpen then
		p375:close()
	else
		p375:open()
	end
end

local v_u_57 = {
	["twoBone"] = function(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5) -- name: twoBone
		local v6 = p2 - p1
		local v7 = v6.Magnitude
		local v8 = v7 <= 0.0001 and Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) or v6 / v7
		local v9 = p3 + p4
		local v10 = v9 * 0.96
		if v10 < v7 then
			local v11 = v7 - v10
			local v12 = v9 - v10
			local v13 = -v11 / v12
			v7 = v10 + v12 * (1 - math.exp(v13))
		end
		local v14 = p3 - p4
		local v15 = math.abs(v14) + 0.02
		local v16 = math.max(v7, v15)
		local v17 = (p3 * p3 + v16 * v16 - p4 * p4) / (p3 * 2 * v16)
		local v18 = math.clamp(v17, -1, 1)
		local v19 = 1 - v18 * v18
		local v20 = math.sqrt(v19)
		local v21 = p5 - v8 * p5:Dot(v8)
		if v21.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
			v21 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) - v8 * v8.Z
			if v21.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
				v21 = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) - v8 * v8.X
			end
		end
		local v22 = v21.Unit
		return p1 + v8 * (p3 * v18) + v22 * (p3 * v20), p1 + v8 * v16
	end,
	["aim"] = function(p23, p24, p25, p26, p27) -- name: aim
		local v28 = p24 - p23
		local v29 = p26 - p25
		if v28.Magnitude < 0.0001 or v29.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
			return CFrame.new(p25 - p23)
		end
		local v30 = -v28.Unit
		local v31 = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) - v30 * v30.X
		local v32 = v31.Magnitude <= 0.0001 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or v31.Unit
		local v33 = v32:Cross(v30)
		local v34 = -v29.Unit
		local v35 = p27 - v34 * p27:Dot(v34)
		if v35.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
			local v36 = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) - v34 * v34.X
			v35 = v36.Magnitude < 0.0001 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or v36
		end
		local v37 = v35.Unit
		local v38 = v37:Cross(v34)
		local v39 = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v37, v34, v38) * CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v32, v30, v33):Inverse()
		return CFrame.new(p25 - v39:VectorToWorldSpace(p23)) * v39
	end,
	["hingeAxis"] = function(p40, p41, p42, p43) -- name: hingeAxis
		local v44 = p40 - p41
		local v45 = v44.Magnitude <= 0.0001 and Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) or v44.Unit
		local v46 = p42 - v45 * p42:Dot(v45)
		if v46.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
			v46 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) - v45 * v45.Z
		end
		local v47 = v46.Unit
		if p43 then
			v47 = -v47
		end

local v_u_1 = {}

function v_u_1.new(p3) -- name: new
	return {
		["current"] = nil,
		["previous"] = nil,
		["start"] = 0,
		["time"] = 0.1,
		["lift"] = nil,
		["current"] = p3
	}
end
function v_u_1.update(p4, p5, p6, p7) -- name: update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	if p4.current ~= p5 then
		if v_u_1.busy(p4) then
			local v_u_8 = v_u_1.get(p4)
			function p4.previous()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
				return v_u_8
			end
		else
			p4.previous = p4.current
		end
		p4.current = p5
		p4.time = p6 or 0.1
		p4.start = v_u_2()
		p4.lift = p7
	end
end
function v_u_1.get(p9) -- name: get
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v10 = p9.current()
	if not p9.previous then
		return v10
	end
	local v11 = (v_u_2() - p9.start) / p9.time
	if v11 >= 1 then
		p9.previous = nil
		return v10
	end
	local v12 = v11 * v11 * (3 - 2 * v11)
	local v13 = p9.previous():Lerp(v10, v12)
	if p9.lift then
		local v14 = p9.lift
		local v15 = 3.141592653589793 * v11
		v13 = v13 + v14 * math.sin(v15)
	end
	return v13
end
function v_u_1.busy(p16) -- name: busy
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v17
	if p16.previous == nil then
		v17 = false
	else
		v17 = v_u_2() - p16.start < p16.time
	end
	return v17
end

local function v_u_250(p222, p223) -- name: softHit
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_195, (copy) v_u_196

local function v_u_515() -- name: anyHeld

		for _, v513 in v_u_3:GetGamepadState(v512) do
			local v514 = v513.KeyCode
			if v514 == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 or v514 == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2 then

end

local function v_u_52(p36, p37, p38) -- name: onState
